CustomField.description: Written by the `FQS_Gift_Acknowledgement` flow. `To Be Sent` (default) queues the gift for the daily run; `Sent` stamps `AcknowledgementDate`. Clearing back to `To Be Sent` re-queues on next daily run.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave as To Be Sent for the daily acknowledgement flow to pick up. Sent stamps Acknowledgement Date; clear back to To Be Sent to re-queue.
